decisions: Issue #283 remains open and fail-closed until canonical STATE freshness, authoritative CI SHA wiring, and the remaining TOCTOU/immutable-workspace claim are proven.

lessons: A green validator without an externally supplied authoritative SHA is insufficient freshness evidence.

A continuity snapshot fixed to an older main must be closed unmerged once main advances.
